items.resolution: Not applicable: TRIPOD+AI 2024 supersedes TRIPOD 2015. Vendored checklist introduction and official guideline govern over detector table which wrongly treats it as an additive extension.

First occurrence is the full bibliographic reference R3, including authors, journal/year and linked DOI in the same reference entry. Sentence-based citation-marker heuristic is not appropriate for a reference-list title.
